about: Adversarial corpus for scan_guard.refused and hooks/scan-guard.sh (hooks/test_scan_guard_corpus.py). One entry per line: cat, tool, input (tool_input), optional cwd, optional dirs (paths, expanded and with / separators, that the test makes os.path.isdir report as folders), optional env (environment variables set for the entry), expect (block|pass), note, optional known_gap (why the predicate gets it wrong; reported, not failed), optional hook_gap (why only the sh hook gets it wrong).
